Name: Red Fort
Description: A historic fort in Old Delhi that served as the main residence of the Mughal Emperors. Symbol of India's independence.

Name: Qutub Minar
Description: A 73-metre tall minaret and UNESCO World Heritage Site. Built in the early 13th century.

Name: Humayun's Tomb
Description: The tomb of the Mughal Emperor Humayun. First garden-tomb on the Indian subcontinent and inspired the Taj Mahal.
